findings.evidence:
`pkg/executor/operate_ddl_jobs.go`: `AlterDDLJobExec.updateReorgMeta()` sets `job.AdminOperator = byWho` when altering `thread`/`batch_size`.
`pkg/ddl/ddl.go`: `resumePausedJob()` enforces “paused job should only be resumed by who paused it” via `if job.AdminOperator != byWho { ... }`.
`pkg/ddl/job_submitter.go`: during upgrading, user DDL jobs are paused by system via `pauseRunningJob(job, model.AdminCommandBySystem)`.
`pkg/session/sync_upgrade.go`: `SyncNormalRunning()` calls `ddl.ResumeAllJobsBySystem()`, which relies on `AdminCommandBySystem` to resume system-paused jobs.
findings.fix: Do not overwrite `job.AdminOperator` in `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS` (leave pause/resume/cancel ownership intact). If audit is needed, add a separate field for “last altered by” instead of reusing `AdminOperator`.
findings.impact:
A SUPER user can run `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS ...` on a system-paused job (e.g., paused during cluster upgrade), which flips `AdminOperator` to end-user and:
- lets end users resume jobs that were intentionally paused by system safeguards, and/or
- prevents `Resume(All)JobsBySystem` from resuming those jobs later (job may stay stuck paused after upgrade).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed as of `upstream/master` (e.g., `pkg/executor/operate_ddl_jobs.go` still assigns `job.AdminOperator = byWho` in `updateReorgMeta`).
findings.verify: Regression test: create a job with `State=Paused` and `AdminOperator=AdminCommandBySystem`, run `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS ... thread/batch_size ...`, assert `AdminOperator` remains `AdminCommandBySystem`; then assert end-user resume still fails while `ResumeJobsBySystem/ResumeAllJobsBySystem` succeeds.
findings.what: `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS` incorrectly mutates `Job.AdminOperator`, which is also used as the pause/resume ownership guard (system vs end user). This breaks the DDL job pause/resume state-machine invariant, especially for system-paused jobs during upgrading.

subject: ddl: support modify the related reorg config by SQL (#57336)
summary: Adds `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS` (planner+executor) to update per-job reorg `thread`/`batch_size` in `mysql.tidb_ddl_job.job_meta`, plus `Job.IsAlterable()`. Found one High issue: the alter path overwrites `Job.AdminOperator`, which is also used to enforce who may resume a paused job (system vs end user), breaking upgrade-related pause/resume invariants.
